other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Must be a son or daughter of a farmer
Parents of the beneficiary should not have agricultural land
Applicant should not be an income taxpayer
benefits_summary: Provides capital subsidies of up to 20% of project cost (maximum ₹18 lakh) and interest subsidies of 5‑6% per annum for up to 7 years for eligible farmer‑son/daughter entrepreneurs.
